sections.title: Writing for Children: Magic, Demons, Activism (A)
sections.description: A creative writing workshop devoted to the art and practice of writing for children. Students can expect to read texts by a variety of practitioners of the genre, complete regular writing assignments, and workshop writing by their peers. To learn more about this course, visit the Creative Writing Program at https://creative.writing.upenn.edu. This is an Academically Based Community Service (ABCS) course.
